name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with knees hovering an inch off the floor, back flat.
Crawl forward by moving opposite hand and foot together — right hand with left foot.
Keep hips low and level; don't let them rock side to side.
Crawl for distance or time, then rest. A full-body coordination and core builder.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate just your bodyweight core exercise for the full-body. Bear Crawl builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
